cause_quote: The diff removed `entry.refreshAt = Date.now() + AGENT_IDENTITY_CACHE_TTL_MS;` and replaced the roster freshness check with `return !cached?.result || identities.get(agentId) !== cached?.result?.identity;`, so a successful identity read no longer expired after a file save.
user_saw: An open Control UI tab could keep showing an agent’s old name or avatar after a successful Gateway save to IDENTITY.md.
summary: After a Gateway RPC commits an IDENTITY.md write, the Gateway notifies open Control UI tabs so they refresh the affected identity without restoring idle polling.
reasoning: The parent of #167968 already had both file-write RPCs, and its identity cache fetched fresh data on the next refresh after the 60-second TTL expired. The prior test assertions covered avatar revalidation without an event, and #167968 changed them to require explicit invalidation while successful file writes still emitted no identity-change event.
